name: Futanari have a heart too
source:
Step into the shoes of Diana, a confident young woman who transfers to the all-female academy Spring Dawn in search of a peaceful new beginning — a life free from the complications of men.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4119390/Futanari_have_a_heart_too/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演戴安娜，一位自信的年轻女性，转学到全女子学院春黎明，寻找一个和平的新开始——一种没有男人烦恼的生活。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4119390/Futanari_have_a_heart_too/]Steam[/url]]
